name: Malidalu
instructions: 1. Knead the wheat flour with water and a pinch of salt to make soft dough.
2. Roll the dough into thick rotis and cook them on a griddle (tava) using a little ghee until golden brown.
3. While the rotis are still warm, tear them into small pieces and grind them coarsely in a mixer or crumble them by hand.
4. Melt the jaggery in a pan with a small amount of water to create a thick syrup and strain it to remove impurities.
5. Add the crumbled roti pieces into the jaggery syrup along with cardamom powder and a generous amount of ghee.
6. Mix thoroughly until the syrup is absorbed by the roti, shape into laddus or serve as a crumble.
description: Malidalu is a traditional, energy-dense dessert from Telangana, often prepared during festivals and auspicious occasions. It represents the rustic culinary heritage of the region, utilizing staple ingredients like wheat and jaggery to create a comforting, nutritious treat.
